exposure: reduced functional capacity (New York Heart Association classification)
cohort: The study included 120 pregnant women with pulmonary hypertension (PAH) who underwent cesarean delivery between January 2015 and December 2022.
finding: Advanced maternal age, higher BMI, severe PAH classification, reduced functional capacity, elevated pulmonary artery pressure, and right ventricular dysfunction were identified as significant preoperative risk factors for PAH crisis in pregnant women undergoing cesarean delivery, with patients experiencing a PAH crisis having longer hospital stays and lower postpartum physical activity levels.
